english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for tolerating something unpleasant or painful.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for bearing or enduring something unpleasant.
Use this when someone endures or puts up with another person’s insults, behavior, or other unpleasant treatment.

examples.english: I can't endure this much noise.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jan2 sau6 m4 dou2 gam3 cou4

examples.english: I really can't tolerate this kind of noise.
examples.traditional: 我真係忍受唔到呢種噪音。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jan2 sau6 m4 dou3 ni1 zung2 cou3 jam1

examples.english: I can't suffer him yelling at me every day.
examples.traditional: 我忍受唔到佢日日鬧我。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jan2 sau6 m4 dou2 keoi5 jat6 jat6 naau6 ngo5
